items.change: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on Uriah's map, and the party planned to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
items.impact_basis: beat_60 adds two key locations to the map and beat_51 makes a marked site part of the route, a clear change to how the map is used.
items.lasting_basis: The marked map guides the trip already under way in beat_51 and the treasure remains unfound.

items.change: George revealed that the dragon's lair lies north at the foot of the mountains and that it will soon fly, and he and Father William said only Brandon's magic sword can kill it.
items.impact_basis: beat_63 answers where the lair is and adds urgency, beat_64 details its lethal powers, and beat_54 and beat_66 make the sword essential, reshaping the hunt.
items.lasting_basis: These facts set the party's main course toward the sword and the lair for later sessions.

items.change: The party trapped the invisible Clurichen Naggeneen in the Golden Egg's basement, learned he was a drinker emptying the bars, and Quinn hung him in a bag behind the bar.
items.impact_basis: beat_20 captures the creature, beat_21 answers what it was, and beat_24 shows Quinn taking him captive, which ended the nightly thefts.
items.lasting_basis: beat_26 shows Naggeneen still held captive, and his offer of gold or a secret in beat_22 could resurface.

items.change: Nothing noteworthy happened; the shipments still had not arrived.
items.impact_basis: beat_39 only restates that the shipments are missing.
items.lasting_basis: The mystery continues unchanged, so this mention adds nothing.

items.change: Dunk offered 20 gold for the mule, and Gill said he would lower his price only once his sons return.
items.impact_basis: beat_3 is a small renegotiation with no deal struck.
items.lasting_basis: The price change depends on Gill's sons returning, so it may come up again later but only in a minor way.

items.change: The bar thief was caught and Quinn paid Sir Phidipaldi, Trout and Dr. Uriah 33 gold each, resolving the job.
items.impact_basis: beat_20 and beat_25 complete and pay out the job, which clearly changes the thread's situation.
items.lasting_basis: The job is resolved and paid in ordinary gold, so it mattered mostly within the session.

items.change: Trout recruited the halfling Squints into his 'Halfling Corps' with promised treasure terms, and Squints later freed Brother Dirk, who Trout put under his command.
items.impact_basis: beat_42 adds a new companion on stated terms, and beat_84 and beat_90 show him in action and taking charge of Dirk.
items.lasting_basis: Squints's terms, including second pick of the first treasure, and Trout's secret plan not to rescue him (beat_83) will shape later sessions.

items.change: Dunk discovered a glowing magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and told the party he has a plan to get it.
items.impact_basis: beat_13 reveals a meaningful magical item and beat_46 commits Dunk to acquiring it.
items.lasting_basis: Dunk's plan to obtain the shirt, tied to the potion scheme, is clearly set for later sessions.

items.change: Learning Ingrid's secret love for Warwick, Dunk struck a deal for her to brew a sleeping potion for the smith, fetched faun wine for it, and secretly diluted the wine before handing it over.
items.impact_basis: beat_33 reveals her secret, beat_35 sets the deal, and beat_72 and beat_78 deliver the key ingredient with Dunk's hidden dilution.
items.lasting_basis: beat_79 sets a meeting for tonight, and Dunk's leverage over Ingrid (beat_38) and the diluted potion will shape what follows.

items.change: Having learned that the dragon can only be killed with the magic sword buried with Brandon, the party set out for the Barrow Mound to get it.
items.impact_basis: beat_54 establishes the sword's necessity and beat_51 commits the party to the journey, a new main goal.
items.lasting_basis: Retrieving the sword is the party's active objective going into the next session.

items.change: Dr. Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep.
items.impact_basis: beat_59 records a minor agreement made at the priest's request.
items.lasting_basis: The unfulfilled promise is likely to come up when the party reaches the Barrow.

items.change: The party found a giant's cottage in the woods, stole its captive Brother Dirk from under it, and outran it.
items.impact_basis: beat_84 reveals and frees the captive as the giant wakes, and beat_86 shows the escape, introducing a new dangerous foe.
items.lasting_basis: The giant still lives on the route north and has been robbed, so it may return.

items.change: Ingrid's shop sells healing mandrake tea, magic-detecting witch powder and wolfsbane.
items.impact_basis: beat_31 only lists the shop's wares.
items.lasting_basis: It is useful shopping knowledge but unlikely to shape play much.

items.change: Father William offered to heal Uriah if he is injured.
items.impact_basis: beat_57 is a small offer of help.
items.lasting_basis: It could matter if Uriah is hurt, but it is incidental.

items.change: Ingrid said that fairies who once stayed hidden are encroaching more often, and that she sees them while visiting her forest friend Vivian.
items.impact_basis: beat_74 adds background lore about rising fairy activity.
items.lasting_basis: The fairy encroachment and Vivian may tie into the sword's fairy origin later.

items.change: Dr. Uriah bought wolfsbane and mandrake tea from Ingrid.
items.impact_basis: beat_77 is a routine purchase.
items.lasting_basis: These are minor consumables.

items.change: Dunk drank with Farmer Gill, got offered a bed in the barn, and haggled over the mule.
items.impact_basis: Only beat_3 adjusts the mule's price, a small change.
items.lasting_basis: Little carries forward beyond the mule terms.
items.encounter_basis: A casual evening of drinking and haggling whose only substance, the mule offer, is already told by thread_7.

items.change: Trout befriended the hopeful halfling Squints at the Clumsy Fox and invited him to meet the party.
items.impact_basis: beat_7 and beat_8 introduce Squints, a prelude to his recruitment.
items.lasting_basis: Its significance lies in the later recruitment told by thread_9.
items.encounter_basis: The first meeting with Squints is a lead-in to the recruitment that thread_9 already tells; the rest is logistics and eavesdropping.

items.change: Dunk peeked into Warwick's shop at night, spotting the glowing mithril shirt and the open bedroom window, and startled a frazzled woman.
items.impact_basis: beat_13 is the key discovery, already carried by thread_10.
items.lasting_basis: The shirt and the window matter for Dunk's plan.
items.encounter_basis: A solo scouting peek whose central discovery is the same as thread_10's.

items.change: In the Golden Egg's basement the party trapped the invisible Clurichen with marbles and ink, bagged him, and handed him to Quinn for a reward.
items.impact_basis: beat_20 and beat_24 resolve the thefts and make Naggeneen a captive.
items.lasting_basis: Naggeneen remains captive with his offer standing.
items.encounter_basis: A pivotal and memorable capture, but it is the same event told by thread_3 and thread_8.

items.change: Trout and Uriah watched the Clurichen swim the river with a jug and followed its footprints.
items.impact_basis: beat_29 sets up the chase but changes little.
items.lasting_basis: The stakeout is transient.
items.encounter_basis: A stakeout that leads into the capture already told by thread_3.

items.change: Dunk followed Ingrid home, learned of her secret love for Warwick, and proposed a sleeping-potion deal that needs faun wine.
items.impact_basis: beat_33, beat_35 and beat_36 establish the bargain and its ingredient.
items.lasting_basis: The bargain and Dunk's leverage continue into later sessions.
items.encounter_basis: The defining negotiation with Ingrid, which is the same bargain thread_11 tells.

items.change: At the Clumsy Fox, Trout enlisted Squints into the Halfling Corps, the party pooled what it had learned about the dragon, and it decided to go to the Barrow for the sword.
items.impact_basis: beat_42 and beat_51 set a new companion and a new objective.
items.lasting_basis: Both the recruitment and the journey carry forward.
items.encounter_basis: A planning and recruitment gathering whose central events are already told by thread_9 and thread_12.

items.change: Dr. Uriah visited the prejudiced Father William, who measured his hands and feet for webbing, explained that the dragon needs Brandon's sword, marked his map, and extracted a promise of penance.
items.impact_basis: beat_54 and beat_60 give key information and map marks, and beat_59 adds an obligation.
items.lasting_basis: The priest's hostility, the penance and the map marks will recur.
items.encounter_basis: A memorable, hostile yet informative meeting with the town priest that gives personal context beyond the separate discoveries made there.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi visited one-armed George the Hunter, who described the dragon's lair and deadly powers and the legend of Brandon's sword.
items.impact_basis: beat_63, beat_64 and beat_66 reshape the dragon hunt.
items.lasting_basis: This information guides the hunt going forward.
items.encounter_basis: A vivid information meeting with George whose central learning is the same as thread_2's headline.

items.change: Dunk danced with the fauns, astonished them by drinking their wine with no effect, and traded a child's lucky rabbit's foot for a flask of faun wine.
items.impact_basis: beat_72 obtains the potion ingredient, and beat_69 shows Dunk's remarkable tolerance.
items.lasting_basis: The wine feeds the ongoing potion scheme.
items.encounter_basis: A distinctive encounter with the fauns and a sentimental trade, separate from the Ingrid bargain that thread_11 headlines.

items.change: Dr. Uriah bonded with Ingrid over their dislike of Father William, hearing her view of the forest faith and the encroaching fairies, and bought her remedies.
items.impact_basis: beat_73 through beat_75 add context and rapport, and beat_77 is a purchase.
items.lasting_basis: The rapport with Ingrid and the fairy lore may come up again.
items.encounter_basis: A friendly exchange that gives personal and world context and counters the priest's view, which would otherwise be lost.

items.change: Dunk handed Ingrid the secretly diluted faun wine, and she began work on the potion.
items.impact_basis: beat_78 advances the scheme with a hidden twist.
items.lasting_basis: The diluted potion and tonight's meeting carry forward.
items.encounter_basis: A short handoff that is part of the bargain already told by thread_11.

items.change: At a giant's cottage, Squints, sent in to prove himself, freed a captive Brother Dirk as the giant woke, and the party escaped; the shaken Dirk wanted to go home and was placed under Squints.
items.impact_basis: beat_84 and beat_86 rescue Dirk and escape a new foe, and beat_89 shows the church's dragon-slayer faltering.
items.lasting_basis: The giant remains on the route, and Dirk now travels under Squints.
items.encounter_basis: A pivotal rescue and escape, the same central event that thread_14 tells.
